name: fonts
title: Fonts
description: Inter body text, Open Runde headings, and Geist Mono for code and charts.
docs:
Install Open Runde files into public/fonts before using the local font loader.

Apply leguanFontVariables to your root html element.

Download fonts:
mkdir -p public/fonts
curl -fsSL https://leguan-ui.pages.dev/fonts/OpenRunde-Regular.woff2 -o public/fonts/OpenRunde-Regular.woff2
curl -fsSL https://leguan-ui.pages.dev/fonts/OpenRunde-Medium.woff2 -o public/fonts/OpenRunde-Medium.woff2
curl -fsSL https://leguan-ui.pages.dev/fonts/OpenRunde-Semibold.woff2 -o public/fonts/OpenRunde-Semibold.woff2
curl -fsSL https://leguan-ui.pages.dev/fonts/OpenRunde-Bold.woff2 -o public/fonts/OpenRunde-Bold.woff2
